text:
emma: Heads up: mobile customers reporting rapid reconnects after we started routing by resume-token affinity. Seeing lots of short SSE sessions and billing anomalies.
hassan: Token affinity should reduce fanout. Can you share example traces and resume_token values?
emma: Attached in console. Observed resume_token reused across different backend shards (race) leading to immediate half-close on resume and client reconnect.
yvonne: If resume_token lands on wrong shard, the proxy replies with 204 halfclose and client retries -> churn.
sre-bot: ALERT: tenant=t-21 reconnect_spike detected at 1811112248.
hassan: Quick mitigation: route resume-token lookups to a consistent hash ring with a fallback window instead of immediate hard fail. I can flip a config: resume_strict=false which allows a 500ms lookup retry.
embma_typo: (typo) emma: ^^ meant emma: sounds good.
console-dev: Add console annotation and a small tile showing resume_mismatch.count by tenant and shard. That will help CS.
billing-bot: BILLING: duplicate_open_event detected for tenant t-21 x 54 in 10m.
yvonne: For immediate risk reduction flip resume_strict=false for affected shards; also throttle client reconnect attempts server-side for 2s if resume failed.
hassan: I'll push a canary change for eu-shard-1; it's a simple proxy flag.
console-dev: Added banner: "canary: relaxed resume strictness" and increased trace sampling for /v1/stream resumes.
sre-bot: NOTE: sampling increased for route /v1/stream for 20m.
hassan: Canary applied. Early signal: reconnects down ~55%, duplicate opens reduced.
embma_typo: emma: good catch on tracing.
yvonne: Follow-ups: (1) fix consistent-hash bug in token assignment path; (2) add resume_mismatch metric and alert with tenant tag; (3) update billing to dedupe opens within 3s if a resume token was present.
billing-bot: METRIC: billing.open_dedup_applied tenant=t-21 count=42 at 1811112275.
emma: OK will monitor for 15m then roll to other EU shards slowly. Also adding a quick note for SDK teams: prefer exponential backoff jitter on resume.
console-dev: Will add an "expected resume failures" hint on the route view while the canary is active to reduce support noise.
hassan: Filed PR for consistent-hash fix and a longer-term migration plan: https://git.company/infra/pulls/321
yvonne: Thanks all. Action items listed in the thread. Closing after 20m stable.
